From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Renewal velocity healthcheck & 3/1 pipeline hygiene

Team —

Quick heads-up before the week: finance asked for a concise renewal velocity healthcheck for all at-risk accounts by EOD Wed (3/3). I want a short, topline update we can present to FP&A on Thursday morning. Focus on current committed ARR, renewal probability, and the single biggest risk for each account.

Ask (for the spreadsheet I attached):
- Row per account: account name, ARR, renewal month, current stage, committed? (Y/N), probability %, churn triggers (one line), next best action owner and ETA.
- Highlight accounts with >= $150k ARR and probability <= 70% — we need a mitigation plan.
- Mark anything requiring credits or legal exceptions so procurement/finance can pre-review.

I started a sheet (renewal-velocity-scorecard-2027Q1.xlsx) with the accounts I pulled from HubSpot. Please fill your rows and ping me if you need deeper data. Monica — can you take Brightline? Vivek — please validate any ask that spans billing/credits. Laura — run a quick freshness pass on stages for anything > 60 days in Negotiation.

I want a one-slide summary for FP&A (2 bullets: net at-risk ARR, top 3 mitigation asks) — I will draft once I get the table.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Soojin — taking Brightline. Quick update (I filled the sheet rows and pasted summary below):

- Brightline Health — $320,000 ARR, renewal Apr-2027, stage: Contract Review, committed: N, prob: 55%
  - Churn trigger: budget re-org + procurement RFP (procurement@brightlinehealth.com).
  - Ask: Procurement requested a renewal term variation and a one-time invoice timing change to align with fiscal year. Finance needs to confirm revenue recognition impact.
  - Next action: I will schedule a 30-min alignment with Alice (Brightline) and Procurement on Wed 3/3. Owner: Monica.

- Meridian Labs — $180,000 ARR, renewal Jun-2027, stage: Negotiation, committed: N, prob: 65%
  - Churn trigger: competing vendor PoC running.
  - Next action: AE to confirm PoC outcome; flagged for enablement follow-up. Owner: Laura.

Net at-risk ARR in my bucket: $500k (Brightline + Meridian + a few small accounts).

I also added a ‘legal exceptions’ column — Brightline may request an invoice timing note and a small payment term tweak. Vivek — I flagged it for you under ‘procurement_flag’.

Thanks — will be on the call with Alice tomorrow and will push for a hard next-step (signed term or revised SOW).

—Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Alice / Brightline procurement —

Thanks for taking time today. Following our call, summary and next steps below for clarity (we'll keep this thread as the single source of truth):

Summary:
- Account: Brightline Health — proposed renewal Apr-2027 for $320,000 ARR.
- Current ask: invoice timing alignment (move 1 invoice from Apr to Jun) + a short-term term variation to align with Brightline fiscal calendar.
- Impact: likely immaterial to Redwood revenue recognition but finance is reviewing for FY27 P&L alignment — Vivek is our point person.

Next steps / owners / ETA:
- Monica: circulate a proposed term note and update the HubSpot deal row (by EOD Thu 3/4).
- Vivek: confirm P&L impact and whether finance approval is required (by Fri 3/5).
- Brightline procurement: confirm whether invoice timing solves the internal procurement requirement or if you need a custom SOW amendment (please reply here).
- Soojin: I will prepare the 1-slide FP&A summary after the sheet is finalized and present on Thu.

Attachments: renewal-velocity-scorecard-2027Q1.xlsx (my filled rows + flagged items), brightline-mop-summary.pdf (notes from today's call).

If procurement needs DocuSign or legal redline templates I can route to Legal, but please confirm ASAP so we don't slip toward renewal month.

Best,
